notes.title: Juicy Army - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!

Today I am incredibly excited to announce that Juicy Army is now available here on Steam.

To everyone who is discovering the game today, welcome to Juicy Army! It's the sweetest action roguelike set in a dream universe where you'll have to fight an army of juicy creatures!

I can't wait to hear what you think about the game, so please let me know your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions over on the Steam forums. I'll be there chatting with you, answering questions, listening, and taking notes! The game will continue to get frequent updates based on your feedback.

Please feel free to leave a review too, that'd really go a long way in further supporting the game beyond launch.

I really hope you will enjoy the game.

Thanks!
